landing_faq_1_question: App eno ekola awatali yintaneti mu byalo?
landing_faq_1_answer: Ebimu ku bikolebwa mu nnimiro bisobola okukola nga tewali yintaneti ne biddamu okusindika ebikwata ku byo nga yintaneti eddwo. Okwekenneenya okw'omu kire (cloud) n'ebikwata ku bintu eby'ebweru byetaaga yintaneti; okubaawo kwayo kisinziira ku kika ky'essimu n'engeri gy'eteekeddwamu.
landing_faq_2_answer: Web application eno ekola ku browser z'essimu. SMS ne USSD zisinziira ku kampuni y'essimu gy'okozesa; tuukirira ekibiina kyo okumanya ebikwata ku ngeri z'okukozesa.
landing_faq_3_question: GPExts ya bwereere eri abalimi abatonotono?
landing_faq_3_answer: Okubaawo n'ebisale bisinziira ku kibiina kyo n'engeri gy'eteekeddwamu. Laba ebikwata ku pulani gy'olimu nga tonnawandiisa.
landing_faq_4_question: Birime ki n'endwadde ki ebiwagirwa kati?
landing_faq_4_answer: Ebitabo by'endwadde birimu ebirime bingi n'embeera ez'enjawulo, naye okubikkirira n'obutuufu by'ebikwata ku byo byawukana. Ebyo ebivuddemu bya magezi, si kigambo kigambibwa nti kyo kituufu ddala; tuukirira omukugu mu kitundu kyo.
landing_faq_5_question: Nsobola okuwuliriza amagezi mu lulimi lwange oluzaaliranwa?
landing_faq_5_answer: Okusegula ennimi n'eddoboozi byawukana okusinziira ku kintu, browser, n'omugabi w'omukutu. Laba ennimi n'eddoboozi ebiriwo mu ngeri gy'eteekeddwamu.
landing_faq_6_question: Abakugu mu by'obulimi (Agricultural Extension Officers) n'Abaminisitule bakozesa batya GPExts?
landing_faq_6_answer: Abakungu b'eby'obulimi bakozesa GPExts ku pikipiki ne mu nnyiriri z'okukyalira ennimiro okulembeja abalimi, okukuba enkula z'ennimiro, okuwandiika ebyafaayo by'okulaba, n'okutegeka okuziyiza okusaasaana kw'endwadde. Minisitule n'ebibiina by'obwegassi bikozesa omukutu gwa yintaneeti okulaba ebifaananyi by'ebitundu ebirimu endwadde n'ebiwandiiko by'ennimiro.
